purpose: relation-direction margin calibration: 8 legal direction pairs, margin only, k=1, no optimiser

set.overlap: entities and sentences are new; no overlap with the frozen relation probes or any pool row
set.assertions: each entity once, same relation word, same tail, nothing else changed

gradients.scope: all 190 parameter tensors, 8 rows, single batch
gradients.upperBoundNote: the weighted sum of norms is an upper bound, not the joint gradient

finding.direction: 8 of 8 generations put the relation in the right order; the failure is a repeated anchor, not a direction error
finding.targetPreference: the model scores its own repeated-anchor sentence 1.2 to 1.5 nats per token above the training target on 8 of 8 rows
finding.disconnect: a direction margin would push on a choice the model already makes correctly, and cannot touch the repetition that keeps the target score low
finding.notSupported: this set does not support starting the direction-loss experiment; it also does not show direction is fine on the harder rows that failed earlier, because this set is single-relation, two-object and one-clause
corrections: inactive negatives are an observation, not a reason to raise m
the weighted sum of norms is an upper bound; the joint gradient is computed here over all 190 parameter tensors and is 12.6 to 25 percent below the bound
